label: Every invariant two-way giver HAS_WILL_1, by the restricted Theta 5 principle
meaning: A two-way giver y with an invariant set-up gives x being at w by some power p (giving exercises a power of the giver) and does not give it at an accessible v where it exists; DNP_inv makes p rational, and a being with a rational power has will. Constructive.
